item.title: The 2026 Mazda CX-5 Cuts Cost To Give Customers More

item.title: Consumer Reports Names Mazda As Its First-Ever Safest New Car Brand
item.description: Mazda is recognized by Consumer Reports as the top-performing brand in its newly released Safety Verdict assessment—an evaluation that sets a new benchmark for how effectively modern vehicles help drivers avoid crashes and protect occupants when one occurs.Read More »

item.title: Porsche, Singapore Artist Priscilla Tey Unveil Lunar New Year Mural For Year Of The Horse
item.description: Porsche has partnered with acclaimed Singaporean artist Priscilla Tey to create a new mural artwork titled “Spirit of Legends,” celebrating the Lunar New Year and Singapore Art Week 2026. The collaboration marks the next cultural commission for Porsche, displayed at its recently launched Porsche at Jewel retail store at Jewel Changi Airport.Read More »

item.title: Ford Now Offering Up To P 1.37M In Discounts Until End Of February
item.description: Ford Philippines is extending its “Drive Now, Pay Later” program until the end of February. This extension provides an additional window for car buyers to take advantage of the flexible financing terms and savings introduced at the start of the year.Read More »

item.title: Chery Alabang Is Chery Auto's 2025 Dealer Of The Year
item.description: Chery Alabang was recognized as the Dealer of the Year at the Chery Grit Awards 2025. This year marks Chery Alabang’s fifth consecutive year of being recognized for its outstanding performance. The award was received by Mr. Mark Chiongbian, Dealer Principal of Frontier Automotive Marilao Corporation (Chery Alabang).Read More »

item.title: Foton San Pablo Named 2025 Foton Dealer Of The Year

item.title: Mazda Makes Endurance Racing History With 2025 Makabayan Cup Sweep
item.description: Mazda made motorsports history by being the first brand to sweep all three legs of the Petron Makabayan Cup. In the process, the #55 Team MSCC Mazda Miata race car set new performance benchmarks proving the MX-5’s balance, reliability, and durability.Read More »
